newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 97 gross intnl reserves seen at $14 bln.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 97 gross intnl reserves seen at $14 bln.

text.p: Philippine Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Friday he expects the country's gross international reserves to rise to about $14 billion this year.
The country's dollar reserves reached $11.7 billion at the end of 1996, up from $7.8 billion at the end of 1995.

In a speech to businessmen, Singson said the higher international reserves could be expected because the Philippines had achieved faster economic growth without compromising price and foreign exchange stability.
